layout.nav.connectors.title: Connectors
layout.nav.connectors.help: Browse external toolkits, connect accounts and review workspace access and tool permissions.
connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.toolsHelp: This is the provider’s catalogue, not a list of tools you can run. Action types are provider labels. When instance catalogue reads are on, eligible users and agents can also use compatible read-only tools in Robots. Unsupported actions are manual.
connectors.toolAction.label: Tool action type
connectors.description: Connect external accounts to your workspace. Catalogue availability, account authentication and permission to execute are separate.
connectors.toolCount: {{count}} catalogue tools · not an execution grant
connectors.filteredPages: Page numbers refer to provider catalogue pages. Domain filters apply within each page; some pages may have no matches.
connectors.accessSeparate: Execution requires effective member and agent access, an active account and an operation allowed by the account policy. Listing a tool grants no access.
connectors.bindProjectRef: Project reference for this existing account
connectors.bindProjectHelp: Enter the 20 lowercase letters from the intended project’s Supabase dashboard. Verification uses this account’s existing token to read project metadata. Once verified, the project cannot be changed on this account.
connectors.errors.supabaseProjectUnprove: The existing account could not verify this project. No binding was saved. Check the project reference and token access before trying again.
connectors.errors.supabaseBindSchema: The provider’s verification tool differs from the version supported by this API. No project was linked. Changing the token will not fix this check.
connectors.errors.supabaseBindAccount: Composio could not confirm that this is a token connection to the hosted Supabase API. No project was linked.
connectors.errors.supabaseBindRead: The connected account could not read the project metadata. Check that it has Project Settings read access for the intended project. No project was linked.
connectors.errors.supabaseBindIdentity: The provider response did not confirm the exact project reference you entered. No project was linked.
connectors.selectSiteHelp: Choose a workspace to browse its available connectors.
connectors.setupHelp: An administrator must review provider configuration. Connectors can use platform credentials when available or an optional workspace Composio key in Integrations. No accounts or access are created automatically.
connectors.revokeOnlyHelp: This principal is no longer eligible for new grants. You can revoke the retained grant, but cannot restore or extend its permissions.
connectors.platformMode: Provider mode: platform-managed Composio credentials. A workspace API key is not required.
connectors.providerModeUnknown: Provider mode is not reported by this server.
connectors.noResultsHelp: Try a different search or domain. Only accounts you can view are included.
connectors.errors.unauthorized: Your session is unavailable. Sign in again, then return to Connectors.
connectors.errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this connector or action. Ask a workspace administrator.
connectors.errors.notFound: This connector is not available to you. Select an account you can access.
connectors.errors.conflict: The connector changed. Refresh status before making another change; your draft was not reapplied.
connectors.errors.expired: This authorization attempt has expired. Return to the catalogue to start a new attempt.
connectors.errors.cancelled: Authorization was cancelled or denied. No successful connection has been confirmed.
connectors.errors.setup: Provider setup or project verification is incomplete. Ask an administrator to review Integrations.
connectors.errors.unknown: The outcome is not confirmed. Refresh status before starting another action; do not assume the operation failed or succeeded.
connectors.errors.unavailable: Connector information is unavailable. No change has been confirmed. Refresh status before trying again.
connectors.errors.providerAuth: Composio rejected the configured API key. An administrator must update the workspace key in Integrations or, when no workspace key is configured, the platform key on the API server. Signing in again will not fix this provider credential error.
connectors.errors.storage: Connector storage is unavailable. An administrator must check database connectivity and required connector migrations.
connectors.errors.apiUnavailable: The connector API is unreachable or not configured. An administrator must check the API server and its configured URL.
connectors.errors.providerResponse: Composio returned an unsupported catalogue or account response. An administrator must review the provider integration before retrying.
connectors.errors.invalidCallback: This callback does not include valid verification proof. Return to Connectors to start a new authorization attempt.
connectors.accountHelp: Select the exact account to review. Account selection never grants permission to use it.
connectors.noVisibleAccounts: There are no accounts available to you for this toolkit.
connectors.noActiveAccounts: No active accounts. Select an account in the header to review its status.
connectors.supabaseDisconnectHelp: This connection can no longer run tools in Makinari. If you connected with a personal access token, revoke it manually in Supabase to invalidate it. Checking provider status does not revoke the token. Revoking it also affects other integrations that use it.
connectors.status.active: Connected and enabled · permissions still apply
connectors.reconnectHelp: If authorization has expired, an administrator can connect again and review the resulting account. Old grants are not transferred automatically.
connectors.workspaceAccessHelp: Workspace access by default. Eligible workspace members and active agents inherit access, including those added later. A saved exception takes precedence, and blocked or expired access does not fall back to the workspace default.
connectors.explicitAccessHelp: Explicit access only. Members and agents need their own active grants. Missing or expired grants deny use.
connectors.managerOnly: Only workspace owners and administrators can review other members’ or agents’ access and edit policies.
connectors.useGranted: You have effective member-use access. Execution still requires an authorized agent, host, tool, active account and current policy.
connectors.noMemberUse: You do not currently have effective member-use access. Managing this account does not grant tool use.
connectors.exceptionsHelp: Add an exception to change who can view or use this connection.
connectors.grantsHelp: Choose who can access this connection.
connectors.noneInherited: No eligible principals inherit workspace access here.
connectors.overrideAllowed: Allowed by exception, subject to policy
connectors.blockOnlyHelp: This principal is no longer eligible. You can block access, but cannot restore or extend it.
connectors.restoreAccessHelp: Restoring access saves an allow exception with no expiry; it does not remove the exception.
connectors.expiryHelp: Uses your local time. Leave empty for no expiry; revocation and policy checks still apply.
connectors.exceptionExpiryHelp: Uses your local time. Leave empty for no expiry. An expired exception blocks access instead of restoring workspace access.
connectors.invalidExpiry: Choose a future expiry or clear the field.
connectors.policyHelp: Choose which tools this account makes available. Turning off instance catalogue reads limits Robots to reviewed tools. Selecting a catalogue entry does not by itself authorize execution.
connectors.allCompatibleHelp: Includes tools reviewed for this connector now and any that become compatible in the future. Instance catalogue reads are a separate setting.
connectors.noExecutableTools: No reviewed tools for this connection yet.
connectors.localRecoveryHelp: The provider catalogue is unavailable. You can still turn off catalogue reads for a connected account without contacting the provider.
connectors.localReadsOff: Catalogue reads are off for this account.
connectors.errors.catalogOptOutSeparate: Save the catalogue opt-out separately. Undo the other policy edits, turn off catalogue reads and save. You can make the other edits afterward.
connectors.catalogReadsAll: When enabled, an instance can discover tools in this account’s catalogue, including future entries, and run compatible reads that pass safety checks.
connectors.catalogReadsSelected: When enabled, an instance can discover only the selected catalogue tools. Only compatible reads among those exact IDs can run.
connectors.catalogReadsLimits: Catalogue reads require direct member and agent access and unrestricted workspace data access. This does not enable Support or approval requests for new tools. Writes, arbitrary SQL and unsupported actions must be handled manually.
connectors.catalogReadsUnavailable: Catalogue reads need a verified, enabled account with interactive assistant access.
connectors.searchTools: Search this toolkit by name, ID or description
connectors.toolLimitReached: Remove a tool before adding another. You can allow up to 100 tools.
connectors.hostAssistant: Supported host: interactive assistant only. Workflows, voice and direct-human execution are not enabled by this policy.
connectors.versionedExecutionBilling: Tools use version-pinned Composio execution. Provider and direct execution charges may apply; platform mode does not imply free usage.
connectors.reviewStale: This request is no longer available as reviewed. Refresh to see what is still pending.
connectors.approvalInboxHelp: Private workspace review. Approve and run executes the exact action below in your name. Neither the decision controls nor the tool result are sent to the customer.
connectors.noApprovals: No actions are waiting for review.
connectors.largeResult: The action completed, but its result was too large to display here.
connectors.approvalRejected: Request rejected. No action was executed.
connectors.approvalUnconfirmed: The decision could not be confirmed. Refresh requests before taking another action.
connectors.approvalHelp: Members and agents with permission can use allowed tools directly. Turn this on so eligible requests without use access can be reviewed in the conversation. Approving runs that action in the reviewer’s name; it does not grant ongoing access.
connectors.publicationAudience: Publish Gmail subject lines in Customer Support
connectors.publicationHelp: Only use a dedicated label for titles intended for this audience. Subject lines on labeled messages, including future messages, can be returned to customers when approval is off. Message bodies, addresses and attachments are never published.
connectors.publicationInvalid: Use a custom label ID such as Label_12345 and allow GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS in the tool policy.
connectors.enableHelp: Requires an active, verified provider account. Enabling uses the account’s existing access and tool policy. Disabling blocks new execution; it cannot undo an action already dispatched.
connectors.connectHelp: You will leave Makinari to authorize an external account. Completion requires server verification.
connectors.workspaceSharingDisclosure: New accounts are shared with eligible workspace members and agents by default, including people and agents added later. Once verified, new connections allow compatible read-only catalogue tools in Robots by default. You can turn off instance catalogue reads or select individual tools in Tools & permissions.
connectors.gmailSharingDisclosure: For Gmail, this can include reading messages from the connected mailbox.
connectors.noAuthConfig: No enabled OAuth 2.0 configuration is available. Ask your Composio project administrator to configure one, then return here.
connectors.managedOAuthHelp: Create a configuration using Composio’s managed OAuth app to request read-only access to Google Calendar events. No client credentials are needed. You will authorize your Google account separately after setup.
connectors.apiKeyUnavailable: This connector accepts an API key. Makinari does not currently verify accounts connected with this method.
connectors.supabaseTokenHelp: This method uses a Supabase personal access token (PAT) starting with sbp_, not a publishable, anon, or service_role project key.
connectors.supabaseTokenBoundary: Use a project-scoped token if available. Project Settings read access verifies the project; Database read access is needed to list tables. Makinari binds table listing to this project, but does not change the token’s permissions. Composio stores the token.
connectors.supabaseProjectRefHelp: Copy the project reference from your Supabase project settings (not the project URL).
connectors.supabaseProjectRefInvalid: Enter the 20-character project reference from Supabase project settings, not the full URL.
connectors.supabaseTokenInvalid: Paste the full personal access token starting with sbp_ from Account → Access Tokens, not a key from Project Settings → API Keys.
connectors.errors.supabaseTokenRejected: The token cannot read this project. Check the project reference and paste a token with Project Settings read access.
connectors.errors.supabaseTokenCheckUnav: Supabase could not verify the token right now. Paste the token again to retry.
connectors.errors.composioProjectSetup: The API server needs the Composio project ID that matches its configured key. Ask your platform administrator to set COMPOSIO_PROJECT_ID, then refresh.
connectors.providerCosts: Provider usage and direct execution costs may apply in either mode, separately from Makinari model credits. Platform-managed credentials do not promise free usage. Instant and automatic paid-tool enabling are not supported.
connectors.revocationRetry: The account is disabled locally, but provider revocation was not dispatched. Review provider setup, then explicitly retry disconnect.
connectors.revocationVerify: Provider revocation may already have been dispatched. Verify provider status instead of retrying disconnect.
connectors.disconnectHelp: This requests local disablement and remote revocation. It cannot undo external actions already dispatched. Remote revocation can remain pending; review the returned status.
connectors.skillsHelp: Procedural guidance and domain relevance do not grant permission to execute tools.
connectors.noSkills: No reviewed related skills are listed for this toolkit.
connectors.noVerification: No verification time is available for the selected account.
connectors.activityHelp: This is the latest account verification, not an execution or audit history.
connectors.callbackHelp: Makinari verifies the provider proof against the initiating account, workspace and authorization attempt. URL status alone is not proof of connection.
connectors.callbackSuccess: Authorization verified. New accounts are shared with eligible workspace members and agents by default. Review this account’s access settings and allowed tools.
connectors.selectAttempt: Select the authorization attempt you started
connectors.selectAttemptHelp: The provider did not identify an attempt. Choose explicitly; no attempt is selected automatically.
connectors.noAttempts: No authorization attempts are available in this browser. Return to Connectors to start again.
